info.title: Xk-rotaract backend API
info.description: Backend operations for the existing frontend: accounts and MFA, organization, membership and history, events, business and coupons. Frontend wiring is unchanged. Outbox queues without delivery claims when SMTP is not configured; no live data migration or payments.

servers.description: Relative same-origin API; no deployed endpoint asserted.

x-global-invariants: Every request rechecks account status and currently valid grants/scopes; hidden or out-of-scope resources uniformly 404.
All mutations require session-bound CSRF plus Origin validation, including anonymous mutations using a pre-session.
Versions are resource-specific; no blind updates. UUIDs immutable. Privacy is checked before query/count/projection.
Critical creates/execute require Idempotency-Key for 24 hours; same actor/path/key with changed body =>409.
Date-only business rules use Asia/Taipei; instants UTC. Membership periods half-open.

SupportCreateRequest.description: legacy_claim requires an exact reviewed stagedRecordId from the separately authorized inventory/import process; other types cannot supply stagedRecordId. For authenticated account_recovery/mfa_recovery, omitted proposedEmail defaults to the requester existing account email. Identity approval alone never changes contact, password or MFA; email possession and final password reset are required. Legacy association requires separate requester confirmation and never merges current UUIDs.

SupportCaseAssigned.description: Assigned support only. subjectAccountId null until evidence securely resolves anonymous recovery request; never approve null subject. Evidence is private and case scoped.

RecoveryCaseCreateRequest.description: Opaque anonymous intake. Optional mfa_recovery selects lost-MFA workflow; clearing MFA requires independent verification, new-email possession and final atomic password reset. Ordinary recovery never clears MFA.
